name: status-mark
title: Status Mark
description: A compact agent-run checklist where each task row carries a small status glyph: a dashed ring while pending, a filling arc while running, and a green tick when done.
use: A task list or agent run log needs a tiny, legible status per row that changes over time.
avoid: The glyph is only 20px, so it needs a text label beside it; alone its meaning is not obvious.
a11y: Each glyph exposes a spoken status through an image role or a hidden prefix, and the spin falls back under reduced motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded card headed AGENT RUN stacks five task rows. Each row starts with a small circular glyph and grey text; completed rows show a solid green circle with a tick and lighter text.
behaves: As each task moves from pending to running its dashed ring thickens into a rotating progress arc, then closes into a filled green circle whose tick is drawn on.
customise: Status, progress, label, four colours, size, stroke width, dash count, spin speed, arc length and draw time are props.
weight: light: A tiny SVG with motion values; the spin runs only while a task is running.
demo: Agent run tasks: Read the repository, Plan the migration, Update 14 call sites, Run the test suite, Open a pull request.
issues: The pending dashed ring and running arc look similar at 20px, so the difference is easy to miss.
polishWhy: The morph from dashed ring to arc to tick is precise and reads well in a dense list.
